selected.title: The WNBA Finals are headed to a first-ever Game 7
selected.summary: Atlanta beat Golden State in Game 6 on October 29, forcing a deciding game in the WNBA Finals for the first time in league history.
selected.why_it_matters: A winner-take-all finale can turn a season into one high-pressure night—and bring new attention to the teams, players and league.
selected.challenge_question: What historic first is happening in the WNBA Finals?
selected.answer_explanation: The reported Game 6 result forced a seventh game, the first time the WNBA Finals have reached that point. The sourced report describes the series milestone and result.
selected.butterfly_question: What makes a winner-take-all game feel different from the rest of a series?
